name: stefangabos/zebra_database
description: An advanced, compact and lightweight MySQL database wrapper library, built around PHP's MySQLi extension.

scripts-descriptions.test-coverage: Runs the test suite and writes an HTML coverage report to tests/coverage-html
scripts-descriptions.check-compat: Checks the library against the supported PHP versions (7.4 and up) - see tests/php-compatibility.xml, where the file to check and the reason for each excluded sniff are kept together
scripts-descriptions.check-compat-legacy: Checks the library against PHP 5.5 and up - the versions it still runs on but that are too old to test against. Uses the same ruleset, overriding only the version to check against
scripts-descriptions.check-style: Checks the library against the coding standard - see coding-standards.xml
scripts-descriptions.fix-style: Fixes what the coding standard check can fix on its own. Look at the diff afterwards - a lot of what it touches is deliberate
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Runs static analysis over the library and the test suite - see phpstan.neon
